items.title: Meta’s new commercial terms will allow the scraping of news sites: experts
items.summary: Meta has updated its commercial terms, enabling the scraping of news sites, which raises significant legal and ethical questions for developers and content creators. This change could impact how news content is aggregated and monetized online, affecting both publishers and tech platforms.

items.title: RPKI now protects 70% of internet routes
items.summary: The Resource Public Key Infrastructure (RPKI) has reached a significant milestone, now securing 70% of internet routes against hijacking and misconfigurations. This advancement is crucial for network engineers as it enhances the overall security and reliability of internet routing.

items.title: Muse Spark Open
items.summary: Meta has launched Muse Spark Open, a new initiative aimed at democratizing access to AI tools for creative expression. This development is significant for developers interested in integrating AI into their applications, providing them with new resources and capabilities.

items.title: Wayland desktop for Linux with skeuomorphic design
items.summary: A new Wayland desktop environment has been introduced for Linux, featuring a skeuomorphic design that aims to enhance user experience. This project is noteworthy for open-source developers looking to create visually appealing and user-friendly desktop environments.

items.title: Any window from your Mac, on your iPhone and iPad
items.summary: A new open-source project allows users to access any window from their Mac on their iPhone and iPad, enhancing cross-device functionality. This tool is particularly relevant for developers seeking to improve mobile productivity and integration with macOS.
